title: Cross-reference: the iPhone Drive original read calls res.blob(), which the engine shim lacks; S62 drive-rest.ts split waits
evidence: The Google Drive original read ends in res.blob() (packages/health-core/src/drive-rest.ts:218-224 driveDownloadDocument, :223), and the engine's fetch shim Response has arrayBuffer, text and json only (ios/engine/shim.ts:166-190 ShimResponse), so reading a filed original on iPhone fails. Another thread fixes it on branch claude/drive-original-read-engine (PR 1672, US-73 AC12). Until that PR merges: the S62 split of drive-rest.ts (over the 500-line file cap, 730 lines) is held, and this thread does not touch drive-rest.ts's download function. US-73 AC12
